description: This file defines a class for handling asynchronous and synchronous HTTP interactions with various LLM APIs and image variation endpoints using aiohttp and httpx. It includes methods for making API calls, managing sessions, handling errors, and integrating with different provider configurations.

classes.name: BaseLLMAIOHTTPHandler
classes.description: A class providing methods for managing aiohttp client sessions, making API calls (both sync and async), handling errors, and processing responses for language model and image variation endpoints.
